coverage_explanation: Tests integer-centimeter output, both valid range endpoints, both adjacent out-of-range values, no-echo blanking, repeated recovery, and response within 250ms. Trigger rising-edge counts provide finite-window sampling-rate coverage. The available checks cannot directly verify each 60..160ms start interval or the exact 25000us echo-wait timeout. A distinct stuck-HIGH echo fault is not modeled by the distance input API, so that fault and the instantaneous initial display state are not independently verified.
assumptions: Authoritative wiring is used: HC-SR04 TRIG D8/ECHO D9 and TM1637 CLK D4/DIO D5; no bench-default LED, button, or analog wiring is needed.
Distance inputs are centimeters synthesized into echo pulses by the host ultrasonic mapping; null represents no echo, not a separately controllable stuck-HIGH fault.
A blank four-digit TM1637 frame is represented by four spaces.
Numeric display checks allow leading zeros or blanks and the specified 1cm quantization tolerance.
